# xudo

> sudo for AI harnesses: root-owned rules decide which exact privileged commands a verified service harness may run.
> Beta; not externally audited. Passwordless execution is off by default.

## Product behavior
- [howiwork](https://github.com/YaminT/xudo/blob/main/howiwork.md): Source of truth and security invariants.
- [README](https://github.com/YaminT/xudo/blob/main/README.md): Install summary and example.
- [Security](https://github.com/YaminT/xudo/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Security boundary, limits, and private reporting route.

## Rules and commands
- [Shipped rules](https://github.com/YaminT/xudo/tree/main/rules): Root-owned TOML policy and examples.
- [xudo(1)](https://github.com/YaminT/xudo/blob/main/docs/man/xudo.1): CLI commands and options.
- [xudo-rules(5)](https://github.com/YaminT/xudo/blob/main/docs/man/xudo-rules.5): Rule, deny-rule, test, pack, and harness registry formats.
- [ido(1)](https://github.com/YaminT/xudo/blob/main/docs/man/ido.1): Human-run queue interface.
- [ido-queue(5)](https://github.com/YaminT/xudo/blob/main/docs/man/ido-queue.5): User-side queue file format.
